requirements.values: Write pytest tests against actual large.chosen_value and consumer.render. chosen_value() returns 42. Built-in ints clamp to 0..100 inclusive: cover negative, both bounds, interior and over-100 inputs. render(value) returns "value=" followed by the decimal clamped value. Tests must detect unclamped, constant-return and incorrect caller-format implementations with assertions.

tasks.objective: Write only the assigned values, types regression tests.
acceptance_checks: Tests pass the real implementation and reject assigned faults.

proposal.rationale: Reviewed experiment: fixed behavior groups and disjoint output ownership; no model planning.
